name: Arc Poke Text
description: A poster headline for React set on a gentle arc, letter by letter: it rises out of per-letter clips in random order when it comes into view, then letters near the cursor lift, swell and lean away, springing back with an elastic wobble. GSAP + ScrollTrigger.

props.name: lines
props.description: The headline, one string per line. Each line is set on its own arc.

props.name: arcDrop
props.description: How far the middle of each line dips, in em.

props.name: arcTilt
props.description: How far the outer letters lean out, in degrees.

props.name: tweaks
props.type: Record<string, {dx?: number; dy?: number; dr?: number}>
props.default: a few nudges for the default text
props.description: Hand nudges per letter keyed 'line:index' (0-based), in em and degrees, on top of the arc. Pass {} for a pure arc.

props.name: poke
props.description: Letters near the pointer lift, swell and lean away (tap on touch).

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each letter takes to rise in.

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' plays when it scrolls into view (right away if it's on screen at load); 'mount' plays at once.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: tracking
props.description: Extra space between letters in em; negative pulls them tighter.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Line height. Keep it tight so the arcs nest; tall faces need a little more.

props.name: className / style
props.description: Font, size and colour. Built for a heavy condensed display face at poster size.
